title: A pinned audio output device fails silently when its endpoint goes stale
description: MPI-803 pins a deviceId. On a box with a virtual mixer the endpoint is not stable: SteelSeries Sonar registers its endpoints late (setSinkId NotFoundError at first play) and churns their GUIDs (a pinned id stops resolving entirely). applySink then falls back to the OS default with nothing but a warn-once in app.log, and Settings re-reads as System default - so the user sees the setting change itself. Needs a decision on how to recover and how to say so.
